name: @minih-plugin/minih.inbox-mail
description: Mail Assistant — watch your mailboxes (a listed provider, a mail server you type in, or either one through an HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy), keep mail in the Inbox panel without notification-centre entries, mark all as read, work through them in one Inbox panel, and let the agent read, reply and write through four tools: two bounded reads that change nothing (usable in a scheduled automation) and two sends the host asks about first.
